Description:
  Wise Owl Inspector — interactive .NET assembly metadata browser.
  Part of the Wise Owl .NET toolchain (https://www.wiseowlsoftware.com).
  
  Free: REPL, --summary, --table, --type, --il, --metadata, --filter, --find.
  Enterprise: --query, --diff, --mcp, --json. See https://www.wiseowlsoftware.com/pricing.

Usage:
  inspector <assembly> [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly>  Path to the .NET assembly to inspect.

Options:
  --summary            Print a high-level summary.
  --metadata           Display all metadata tables.
  --table <table>      Display specific metadata table(s). Repeatable. Names: typedef, methoddef, fielddef, paramdef, typeref, memberref, assemblyref, typespec, methodspec, interfaceimpl, customattr, property, event, constant, genericparam, nestedclass, resource, methodsemantics, methodimpl, standsig, propertymap, eventmap, moduleref, implmap, classlayout, fieldlayout, fieldrva, fieldmarshal, declsecurity, exportedtype, file.
  --il                 Display IL for all methods.
  --dependencies       Show assembly and type dependencies.
  --json               Output structured JSON for tooling. Forces one-shot mode. (Enterprise)
  --filter <filter>    Filter rows. Supports scoped queries like 'type=WeatherForecast', 'parent=OrderDto', 'sig=DateOnly', or unscoped substring match.
  --public-only        Restrict output to public symbols.
  --type <type>        Show a unified view of all types matching the given name pattern: fields, methods, properties, events, custom attributes, MethodImpls, and references. Composable with --il (appends IL for every method in the matched types + their compiler-generated nested types — closures, iterator/async state machines) and --method (narrows to matching names).
  --method <method>    Restrict method-level output (--il, --table methoddef) to methods whose name contains this substring, case-insensitive. ANDs with --type: '--type Foo --method Initialize' catches 'Foo::Initialize' and its synthesized '<Initialize>b__0' lambda.
  --diff <diff>       
[truncated]
